text: APPROVE: Moving the lockfile-reading loop into `ReadHighestLockedVersionsAsync` removes about 9 points of cognitive complexity, taking `CollectAsync` from 17 to roughly 8. The code is moved verbatim (the pragma, `ConfigureAwait`, the exception filter and the highest-version logic), and the signature matches `FindLockfiles`'s `List<string>` return, so behaviour and the build should be unchanged. I judged this from the diff alone and did not build or run anything.
